senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חבב)to seize, to take a pledge. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 1, a. e., v. חֲבוֹלָה.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13">B. Mets. IX, 13</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 115a:17">115ᵃ</cite>) <he>החוֹבֵל את הריחים</he> he who seizes millstones (for his debt); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to twist (v. חֶבֶל); to do violence, unshape; to inflict a wound, to hurt (followed by ב of the object).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> <he>החוֹבֵל בחבירו</he> he who injures his neighbor.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106a:2">Ib. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>חובל בצריך לכלבו</he> one who wounds (an animal on the Sabbath is guilty) when he needs the blood for his dog.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>חובל בעלמא</he> one who wounds generally (not for a purpose); a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 351:2">Yalk. Ex. 351</cite> <he>שניתן לֵיחָבֵל ביום</he> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 114b:9">B. Mets. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>לַחֲבוֹל</he>) which may be seized as a pledge in day time.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:29">Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 29</cite> <he>אע״פ שלא … מן הנֶחְבָּל וכ׳</he> although the injurer does not ask the injured (to pray for him), the injured must pray &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to injure, wound; to unshape, ruin, spoil.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 51a:13">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>יש לי</he> … <he>לחַבֵּל</he> I have permission to injure (kill).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 91b:1">B. Kam. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>לחַבֵּל בעצמו</he> to mutilate one’s self.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:2">Kel. XIV, 2</cite> <he>משיְחַבֵּל</he> from the moment he batters (the tube, for fitting it into the top of the staff); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 5</cite> <he>משיִחְבּוֹל</he>, v. <cite ref="H00107"><he>חָבַר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:2">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (play on <cite ref="H00084"><he>חִבֵּל</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 23:34">Prov. XXIII, 34</cite>) <he>שחִבְּלָתוֹ יעל וכ׳</he> whom Jael mutilated on his head.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 301:1">Yalk. Ex. 301</cite> <he>חִבַּלְתֶּם מעשיכם</he> you have ruined (turned to evil) your deeds.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 24a:9">Snh. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>מְחַבְּלִין זה לזה וכ׳</he> (Ms. K. <he>זה את זה</he>) wound each other’s feelings in discussions; a. fr.
Taan. 8ᵃ bot. מְחַבֶּלֶת ואינה יולדת (Rashi: חוֹבֶלֶת) travails but cannot give birth.—Pass. pass. מְחוּבָּל ruined.

senses.gloss: to be spoiled, ruined. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 1 נותן דבר המְחַבֵּל לתוך דבר המִתְחַבֵּל he puts a thing which spoils (the taste) into a thing which is spoiled.
